Resolves #18439

Two BigData grid arms failed intermittently on hosted runners, each for its own reason.

- **Paint (`ThumbDragPause`):** 8–10 frames blanked because a scroll repaint shipped without its rows. `grid.View#syncBodies` repaints rows silently and ships them in one deep View update. When a body update merged into that queued update, sparse tree generation pruned every row as clean.
- **Selection (`TreeBigData`):** the arm pinned the folder's level-1 sibling, because the toggle's class can land before the rows it reveals.

This PR fixes the engine for the first, and makes the arm's wait observe its state for the second.

Evidence: L3 achieved (a hosted capture of the failing batch; a unit arm that reproduces the pruning, red on `dev` and green with the fix; hosted ×40 on this branch) → L3 required (both modes were hosted-only intermittents).

The 5/20 did not reproduce, and the mechanism does not depend on TreeBigData: it needs a body update waiting behind an in-flight View update, which a loaded runner makes likely. **Selection:** 2/20 (34906759612), plus one PR sighting (34913319806) |

The paint mechanism here needs the finite repaint depth from #17401 (2026-08-20); the selection arm here is the happy path, not the structural ones |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The fix is in the engine, not the pinning addon.** `GridRowScrollPinning` trusts the View's `scrollTop` meta from any batch, which is how the early batch released the pin. Adopting the meta only from batches with rows would strand the pin on a sub-row scroll, which ships none. The rows were late because they had been pruned.
- **A flag, not a changed default.** Sparse generation for depth > 1 is deliberate (#8834, pinned by `SparseUpdates.spec` and `AsymmetricMerging.spec`), and -1 is ruled out for the repaint (#17401). `denseUpdate` lasts one cycle, resets at collection like `updateDepth`, and applies only to the owner that sets it; merged children beyond that owner's depth still ride as disjoint updates. #18439 lists the alternatives: registering every repainted row (one payload collection per row per scroll step), or reordering `ScrollManager#onContainerScroll` (fixes one order, while any other deferred body update can still re-merge). The fork went to @neo-opus-grace as the #17401 owner.
- **The one other site with this shape stays unset, and that is measured, not assumed.** `grid.Body#updateCellPositions` writes cell widths and offsets straight into the mounted rows' vdom, then ships `updateDepth = 2` — the same silent-descendants-at-finite-depth shape. @neo-opus-grace's census names it as the only other exception (`Container#bulkUpdateRecords` ends on a default-depth update, and `Body.mjs:826` uses -1, dense by definition). Probed at this head on the `ScrollFlightMerge` rig: a row update merging into a resize flight does collect it sparse with an allow-list of one row (`ids: ["…row-0"]`, `merged: ["…row-0"]`, `denseUpdate: false`), and every one of the 14 mounted rows still carries the new width afterwards. No oracle at that site separates the two states, so setting the flag there would be a guarantee with no witness. It stays unset, with this probe as the receipt; a real symptom there reopens it.
- **A second merge bug, found on the way and fixed here.** `VDomUpdate#executeCallbacks` cleared every merged child a landing flight had processed, by id. A child that merged again into the parent's queued update while the flight was in the air lost that newer registration, and its change never shipped. Collection now marks what it takes (`VDomUpdate#markMergedCollected`), and landing clears only that: a re-merged child ships with the next cycle, and its promises settle then, not before. A failed flight still rejects every merged child. `AsymmetricMerging.spec` › *Re-merge in flight* is red on `dev` at `the newer change shipped`.

## Test Evidence

- `unit/grid/ScrollFlightMerge.spec.mjs` (bucket B, local): red on `dev` at `every repainted row reached the DOM`, with the repaint payload built at depth 4 and `[body]` as its allow-list; green with the fix. A probe variant with the body update after the repaint was green on `dev`, because the allow-list is gone by collection, so the arm uses the hosted order.
- Full unit suite: 4069 passed, 2 skipped. The sparse and merge specs (`SparseUpdates`, `AsymmetricMerging` with its new arm, `AsymmetricUpdates`, `HelperNeoIgnore`, `TreeBuilder`, `Teleportation`, `Pooling`, `RaceCondition`) pass, and `VdomDestroyCancellation` stays green: the destroy path still rejects every merged child. One earlier full run failed `UpdateWedge`'s 40 ms watchdog-timer arm, which never touches merging; it passed 3/3 alone and in the rerun.
- Hosted ×40, ThumbDragPause + TreeBigData on this branch: [34915614433](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/34915614433), 240 passed, paint 0/40 and selection 0/40. The same selection on `dev` ran paint 1/40 (34908005335) and selection 2/20 (34906759612).
